label: Airtable pulls
description: One record per check that found Airtable edits: what was found and written to Swell

table.description: App table whose Airtable edits were read

status.description: running: the check continues on the next run (out of time or a retryable error); completed: done

found.description: Records with Airtable edits found in this check

changed.description: Records updated in Swell in this check

failed.description: Edits Swell rejected or cells that couldn't be read in this check

date_cursor.description: The check reads rows edited after this time

date_pass_started.description: When the check started; the next check reads edits from here (minus a short overlap)

offset.description: Airtable page offset of a running check; the next run continues there, or from the first page when empty
